articles.titleTr: Civil servant who secretly held five jobs found guilty of fraud
articles.summaryTr: Kashim Chowdhury had secretly held multiple public sector jobs on full-time salaries.
articles.articleText: Civil servant who secretly held five jobs found guilty of fraud - Published A civil servant who secretly held multiple public sector jobs on full-time salaries has been found guilty of nine counts of fraud. Kashim Chowdhury, from east London, had five government jobs that overlapped in the spring of 2023. He fraudulently earned more than £284,000 of taxpayers' money. The prosecution accused the 56-year-old of ''deliberate, intentional dishonesty'' and of ''exploiting the system''. After seven hours of deliberation, the jury unanimously found Chowdhury guilty of eight counts of fraud by false representation and one count of fraud by a failure to disclose. The judge said Chowdhury faced a ''very significant custodial sentence''. He added he was refusing bail because of the significance of the crime and for Chowdhury's own wellbeing. 'Abused trust' "This was sustained and deliberate dishonesty," said Sarah Melo, specialist prosecutor at the CPS Serious Economic Organised Crime and International Directorate. "He knew he could not legitimately hold multiple full-time positions at the same time, but continued to conceal what he was doing." A Defra spokesperson said Chowdury "abused the trust placed in him as a public servant", adding that it would use all available avenues to recover the proceeds of Chowdhury's offending. Between 2020 and 2023 Chowdhury had eight full-time public sector roles that overlapped and earned him £350,000 in total. The prosecution told the court that on application forms he provided inaccurate information about his employment status and failed to disclose to government departments that he was already a civil servant. Once he secured the roles he didn't tell his employers he was working elsewhere. He was allowed to work entirely from home because he told his employers he was caring for his mother, whom he lived with in east London. She had dementia and was diagnosed with terminal cancer in 2023. But rather than reduce his workload to look after her, he kept taking on new jobs. In the spring of 2023, when his mother was a few months away from death, he had jobs at the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, the Department of Health and Social Care, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), the Department for Business and Trade, the Food Standards Agency and the Home Office. During this period he was contracted to work 183 hours a week - more than the number of hours that exist in seven days. Chowdhury said he had taken on so many roles because he feared losing his livelihood after experiencing insecure employment in the past. He was made redundant from a job at the Department for Education in 2013 and was given a diagnosis of PTSD. He said he had not been thinking clearly when applying for jobs ''because of my stress, distress and trauma and due to my panic at the time". But the prosecution barrister, Lucy Organ, told the jury: "He's lied to you in evidence, he's lied to you under oath, which demonstrates the level of deceit he has descended to." A succession of his managers told the court about his poor performance. Especially damning was the evidence given by Dan McCartney who managed Chowdhury at Defra. He said he had to "effectively tell him what to do the whole time". McCartney said that during video calls Chowdhury had his camera switched off blaming technical problems. McCartney said this went on for four to five months. But McCartney said that because Chowdhury was not subject to any formal performance measures at Defra, he was given a permanent job and remained there for two years. The prosecution argued that he used sick notes to cope with his impossible schedule. In March 2023, he was on sick leave from four of the organisations he worked for. But he kept working at the Home Office and did not tell them he was ill. His line manager at the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), Aleesha Adams, organised a video call with him in May 2023. By this point he'd been off sick for three months and she wanted to make a plan to get him back to work. She told the jury that at the start of the call he was coughing a lot and waving tissues up to the camera. She also told the jury that he had been wearing white make-up to try to look ill. Adams told the court that as the meeting went on the make-up started coming off his forehead. ''He was sweating, it was like rubbing off so it was darker underneath and darker on the neck." Chowdhury told the jury this was a smear and that he had not been wearing make-up. After the call, Adams discovered that he had logged into the call using a Defra email address. When she challenged him about it he blamed a technical error. Adams grew suspicious. ''I believed he was lying,'' she told the jury. She escalated her concerns up the chain at the UKHSA. But his fraudulent behaviour went on for several more months until he left the civil service in September 2023. He was finally caught in 2024 by the government's National Fraud Initiative, which conducts searches of civil service databases such as payroll every two years to look for anomalies. Chowdhury has also been accused by his siblings of bullying their mother into increasing his share of the family home days before she died. In a case at the High Court, Chowdhury's two brothers and sister allege that he put "undue influence" on Faijun Nessa to sign documents that meant he would inherit half of her home. The four-storey, six-bedroom home in east London has been valued at £2.1m. His siblings say their mother could not have understood what she was signing because she was "desperately unwell". In January 2023 she was given a terminal diagnosis of stage four metastatic colorectal cancer. The claimants also allege that Mrs Nessa, who was nearly blind and could not speak English, was unaware of what she was signing because the documents were not translated into her native Bengali at the time they were signed. Kashim Chowdhury denies the claims. That case is ongoing.

articles.title: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results
articles.summary: Trump made the claims, without evidence, on Truth Social on Monday.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results
articles.summaryTr: Trump made the claims, without evidence, on Truth Social on Monday.
articles.articleText: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results - Published US President Donald Trump has questioned the legitimacy of the midterm election results in which Republicans suffered sweeping losses - days after saying he would accept the outcome. "Does anybody really believe that this 'Election' was honest. How could the Polls be so wrong?" Trump wrote on Truth Social on Monday. This appeared to contradict what he told the New York Times on election night that he was "absolutely willing" to accept the results. Democrats retook both chambers of Congress in last week's elections. State and local officials across the US said voting had been mostly problem-free. Some key races, including Senate contests in Alaska and Mississippi, have yet to be called. In the Truth Social post, Trump made vague claims about polling, voting "dumps", and "machines" without providing specific evidence of error or wrongdoing. He has previously attempted to cast doubts on the integrity of elections he has lost, although he himself was not on the ballot in the midterms. "We would have won easily if I was on the ballot," Trump told CBS News, the BBC's US partner, after it was confirmed his party had lost both the Senate and the House. As it stands, Democrats have won 54 US Senate seats and 254 US House seats in the midterms, giving them comfortable majorities in both chambers of Congress even as counting continues in some races. The outcome has been clear since election night and Trump told the New York Times then: "We'll, you know, look forward to working with [Democrats]", adding: "We'll probably work something out." He has also offered his own analysis of why Republicans lost, acknowledging on Fox News that the Iran war had contributed to the defeat. "People agree with what I'm doing on Iran but they really probably weren't willing to do the short term consequences of paying more for gasoline - I understand that," he said. Vice-President JD Vance has also blamed the Iran war, which began in February and which has severely disrupted global oil and gas supplies - causing costs to soar, as the reason their party lost the election. In the run-up to the midterms, Trump made claims about widespread voting fraud, despite evidence that it is rare. He and his allies alleged for months that the 2020 presidential election, which he lost to former President Joe Biden, had been rigged against him. His lawyers and allies spent weeks attempting to litigate the results, but courts repeatedly struck them down. The justice department during his administration has made unprecedented attempts to exert more federal control over elections - a power the Constitution primarily delegates to individual states. Days before these midterms, it filed controversial lawsuits in federal courts challenging the count and certification of votes in states like California and Alaska, but judges ruled against them in nearly all instances. Election law experts, state officials, and local elections offices told the BBC they had spent months preparing for a scenario in which the White House or election sceptics questioned the votes' legitimacy. Despite the intense focus around election integrity on both sides of the debate, top state and local election officials have reported a mostly smooth process so far for the 2026 midterms. Extreme weather did force some location closures, and a handful of reported administrative or technical issues slowed the process in some local jurisdictions.

articles.articleText: Pegasus'un (PGSUS) 3. çeyrekte beklentileri aştı: İşte bilanço detayları! - Pegasus, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 11,27 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Ancak yılın ilk yarısındaki zarar nedeniyle şirketin 9 aylık toplam net sonucu 1,28 milyar TL zarar oldu. Üçüncü çeyrek kârı piyasa beklentilerini aştı. Pegasus Hava Taşımacılığı A.Ş. (PGSUS), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını 9 Kasım'da Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde 1 milyar 279 milyon 203 bin TL net zarar açıkladı. Pegasus, 2025'in aynı döneminde 13 milyar 326 milyon 666 bin TL net kâr elde etmişti. Buna karşın şirket, yalnızca 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 11 milyar 272 milyon 632 bin TL net kâr kaydetti. Satış gelirleri yüzde 32 arttı Pegasus'un ilk 9 aylık hasılatı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 114 milyar 405 milyon 95 bin TL'den 150 milyar 626 milyon 803 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Böylece satış gelirlerinde yıllık bazda yüzde 32 artış gerçekleşti. Şirketin esas faaliyet kârı ise aynı dönemde 10 milyar 872 milyon 782 bin TL'den 9 milyar 359 milyon 283 bin TL'ye geriledi. FAVÖK, 2025'in ilk 9 ayında 30 milyar 246 milyon 178 bin TL seviyesindeyken, 2026'nın aynı döneminde 26 milyar 518 milyon 410 bin TL olarak gerçekleşti. Pegasus'un varlıkları 492 milyar TL'yi aştı Şirketin toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 410 milyar 168 milyon 212 bin TL'den 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği sonunda 492 milyar 104 milyon 652 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 293 milyar 314 milyon 340 bin TL'den 360 milyar 369 milyon 107 bin TL'ye çıktı. Özkaynaklar ise 116 milyar 853 milyon 872 bin TL'den 131 milyar 735 milyon 545 bin TL'ye ulaştı. Pegasus'un piyasa değeri 73,25 milyar TL, PD/DD oranı ise 0,56 olarak açıklandı. Pegasus bilançosu beklentileri aştı Matriks Haber tarafından gerçekleştirilen bilanço anketine 15 aracı kurum katıldı. Ankete göre Pegasus'un üçüncü çeyrek net kârına ilişkin ortalama beklenti 8 milyar 895 milyon 300 bin TL, medyan beklenti ise 8 milyar 834 milyon TL oldu. Şirketin açıkladığı 11 milyar 272 milyon 632 bin TL'lik üçüncü çeyrek net kârı, hem ortalama hem de medyan beklentinin üzerinde gerçekleşti.

articles.title: Nine Zimbabweans caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine
articles.summary: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Nine Zimbabweans caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine
articles.summaryTr: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.
articles.articleText: Nine Zimbabweans caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine - Published Nine Zimbabweans have been arrested in South Africa after they were caught allegedly trying to leave the country to fight in the war between Russia and the Ukraine, police say. The group, aged between 20 and 26, were arrested in and around Johannesburg by a multidisciplinary team on Sunday evening. They were caught as they were "preparing to board flights out of the country", authorities added, but their final destination is unclear. They have been charged with contravening South Africa's Regulation of Foreign Military Assistance Act, which outlaws mercenary activity without government permission. Police said five people were arrested at South Africa's biggest airport, OR Tambo, and another four at a hotel in Bruma, east of Johannesburg by a multidisciplinary team that involved Interpol. All nine later appeared in court, according to state prosecutors. The police statement added that the involvement of Interpol and other international law enforcement agencies indicated that the suspects had also allegedly violated laws in their respective home countries, prompting cooperation with South African authorities. They have also not said whether the group allegedly intended to fight for Russia or Ukraine nor provided details of the organisations allegedly involved in facilitating their travel. Citizens of several African countries, including Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, have gone to fight for Russia in Ukraine - some they had been duped and had not realised where they were going. A Ukrainian intelligence assessment estimated earlier this year that more than 1,700 people from 36 countries in Africa have been recruited to fight for Russia. Kenya at the time estimated that 252 citizens had been illegally conscripted in Russia. In March, Foreign Minister Musalia Mudavadi visited Moscow to address the issue. He said at the time that an agreement had been reached to stop recruiting Kenyan nationals. In March, Zimbabwe said that 15 of its nationals had been killed after being recruited to fight for Russia in Ukraine, with more than 60 still trapped on the frontlines. The previous month, South Africa secured the return of 17 South Africans who were allegedly tricked into joining the war. In December last year, South African authorities arrested five people, including a journalist, for allegedly recruiting people to join the war. Ukraine has also been recruiting foreign nationals, including from Africa. Citizens of several African countries, including Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, have gone to fight for Russia in Ukraine - some they had been duped and had not realised where they were going. A Ukrainian intelligence assessment estimated earlier this year that more than 1,700 people from 36 countries in Africa have been recruited to fight for Russia. Kenya at the time estimated that 252 citizens had been illegally conscripted in Russia. In March, Foreign Minister Musalia Mudavadi visited Moscow to address the issue. He said at the time that an agreement had been reached to stop recruiting Kenyan nationals. In March, Zimbabwe said that 15 of its nationals had been killed after being recruited to fight for Russia in Ukraine, with more than 60 still trapped on the frontlines. The previous month, South Africa secured the return of 17 South Africans who were allegedly tricked into joining the war. In December last year, South African authorities arrested five people, including a journalist, for allegedly recruiting people to join the war. Ukraine has also been recruiting foreign nationals, including from Africa. articles.summary: "It destroys people, but we all make our own choices" - Marseille drug-gang members spoke to the BBC.

articles.titleTr: Men recruited to French gang as children to kill give rare insight into drug underworld
articles.summaryTr: "It destroys people, but we all make our own choices" - Marseille drug-gang members spoke to the BBC.
articles.articleText: Men recruited to French gang as children to kill give rare insight into drug underworld A BBC investigation has found one of Europe's most powerful drug gangs in France is recruiting teenage children from across the country to commit kidnap and murder. Known as the "DZ Mafia", the gang won a bloody turf war against a rival group in Marseille during 2023, and is now recruiting from further afield. One member who is in prison awaiting trial after being implicated in several murders told the BBC he was part of a DZ Mafia hit squad. He agrees the killings he has been charged with were "quite shocking". "Attempts in broad daylight, in traffic jams… it can range from going to hit a guy, slap him to taking him in front of his mother and burning him up in a car. I think I have good composure, I handle it fairly well." When challenged over whether he feels regret when carrying out such acts of brutality, he says he feels "guilty in-part" but claims to have no regrets. Like so many teenagers from Marseille, he knew large sums of money could be earned quickly in drug trafficking. Now in his twenties, he admits the environment he entered was a "trap". The BBC's Paris Correspondent, James Waterhouse, reports from Marseille.

articles.summaryTr: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, fon soruşturmasına ilişkin “Taviz yok” mesajı verirken emeklilerin durumunu iyileştirecek mali imkanlar üzerinde çalışıldığını söyledi. articles.articleText: Erdoğan'dan emekli maaşları için yeni mesaj: “Mali imkanları oluşturuyoruz” - Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, fon soruşturmasına ilişkin “Taviz yok” mesajı verirken emeklilerin durumunu iyileştirecek mali imkanlar üzerinde çalışıldığını söyledi. Gabar'da iki yeni sahadan daha olumlu haber geldiğini belirten Erdoğan, petrol üretimi ve enerji hedeflerine ilişkin açıklamalarda bulundu. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan başkanlığında gerçekleştirilen Kabine toplantısının ardından ekonomi gündemine ilişkin açıklamalar yapıldı. Erdoğan, fon soruşturmasının yakından takip edildiğini belirtirken emekli aylıklarına yönelik yeni düzenleme çalışmalarına ve Gabar'daki petrol faaliyetlerine de değindi. Fon soruşturmasında “taviz yok” mesajı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, fon soruşturmasına ilişkin sürecin yakından takip edildiğini belirterek, “Meseleyi çok sıkı bir şekilde takip ediyoruz. Vatandaşlarımız bize güvenmeye devam etsin” ifadelerini kullandı. Erdoğan'ın açıklaması, soruşturmanın kararlılıkla sürdürüleceği mesajı olarak öne çıktı. Emekli maaşlarına ek zam hazırlığı Kabine toplantısının gündeminde emekli aylıklarına yönelik düzenleme de yer aldı. Erdoğan, emeklilerin ekonomik durumunu iyileştirmeye yönelik çalışmalar hakkında, “Emeklilerimizin durumunu biraz daha iyileştirecek mali imkanları oluşturuyoruz” dedi. Emeklilere enflasyon farkının yanı sıra ek refah payı verilmesine yönelik çalışmalar sürüyor. Hazırlanan taslakların Erdoğan'a sunulmasının ardından düzenlemenin bütçe süreciyle birlikte Meclis gündemine taşınması planlanıyor. Ancak emekli maaşlarına yapılacak olası ek zam oranı ve yeni maaş tutarlarına ilişkin henüz kesin bir rakam açıklanmadı. Gabar'da iki yeni sahadan petrol haberi Erdoğan, Türkiye'nin enerji arz güvenliği ve yerli kaynakların üretime kazandırılması konusunda atılan adımlara da değindi. Karadeniz'de üretilen doğal gazla 4 milyon hanenin ihtiyacının karşılandığını belirten Erdoğan, Osmangazi Gemisi'nin devreye alınmasıyla bu sayının 8 milyona çıkarılmasının hedeflendiğini söyledi. Gabar'daki petrol üretimine ilişkin de açıklamalarda bulunan Erdoğan, bölgede iki yeni sahadan daha olumlu haber geldiğini duyurdu. Gabar'da 75,4 milyon varil Türkiye'nin en kaliteli petrolünün üretildiğini ifade etti. Türkiye'nin enerji sepetini genişletmeye, yerli petrol ve doğal gaz kaynaklarını ekonomiye kazandırmaya yönelik çalışmaların sürdüğünü vurguladı.

articles.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
articles.summary: The cyber-attack last month saw fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets across France heated up.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
articles.summaryTr: The cyber-attack last month saw fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets across France heated up.
articles.articleText: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking - Published France has accused Iran of being behind cyber-attacks that raised the temperatures of supermarket fridges and freezers. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said the attack was carried out by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) of Iran. He said the attack was "unprecedented in both its scale and its level of aggression", adding that the country would "implement sanctions at the European level against all those responsible for this attack". The cyber-attack last month saw fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets across France heated up, which spoilt fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros. Then last week, dozens of supermarkets across seven other European countries were also impacted by a cyber-attack that targeted fridges and freezers. It is not known if the instances are linked. Iran is yet to respond to Barrot's allegations. Barrot said of the attack on France's supermarkets: "It marks the first large-scale cyberattack aimed at sabotage on our national territory, and it constitutes a major attack on the nation's interests and the security of the French people." He said the government had summoned the Iranian ambassador to Paris to "lodge a very strong protest against this extremely grave act". France will take "any other necessary and proportionate measures" to respond to the incident and "deter anyone who might seek to repeat it", Barrot added. Separately on Monday, the Paris prosecutor said an investigation had been opened into the head of an offensive cyber unit associated with Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) as well as his two deputies. Laure Beccuau named the unit as Shahid Kaveh, which she said had an affiliation with the electronic and cyber centre of the IRGC. On 11 October, hackers gained control of the software that regulates the temperatures of the refrigeration units used in many of France's supermarkets. More than 100 of Coopérative U's supermarkets were hit, as well as 180 stores from Intermarché and its Netto brand. In some stores, temperatures of the fridges reportedly rose to 50C (120F) overnight. Other major food retailers including Carrefour, Monoprix and E.Leclerc were also hit by the attack, which targeted software provided by Danish engineering firm Danfoss. The software allows retailers to manage their cold units remotely. Earlier this month a second wave of hacks took place, hitting more than 100 stores across Europe. Supermarkets in Belgium and Luxembourg were affected, while a smaller number of shops were hit in Sweden, Ireland, the Netherlands, Estonia and Finland. Since the waves of attacks on freezers, experts have been speculating which hacking groups could be responsible, with Iran being on a list of potential suspects. In spite of a pair of Russian-aligned hacktivist groups claiming they were responsible on Wednesday, few believed them. The French government has not said how it reached the conclusion that Iran was responsible, and attribution of cyber attacks is extremely hard as hackers are able to hide their locations. articles.title: Poundland unable to buy new stock as fears over collapse grow
articles.summary: The discount chain is continuing to edge towards collapse and is said to be "running on fumes", according to one insider.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Poundland unable to buy new stock as fears over collapse grow
articles.summaryTr: The discount chain is continuing to edge towards collapse and is said to be "running on fumes", according to one insider.
articles.articleText: Poundland unable to buy new stock as fears over collapse grow - Published Poundland is unable to buy new stock to fill its shelves after being blocked by its owners from accessing cash in its bank accounts. The discount chain is on the brink of collapse with one insider describing it as "running on fumes". It has until Thursday to secure a rescue deal. About £50m has been frozen by its American owner Gordon Brothers, the BBC understands, meaning its 600 shops are running out of stock. Pressure is building on Gordon Brothers, which bought Poundland for £1 last June, after the owner rejected a takeover bid that could have saved the thousands of jobs currently at risk. Gordon Brothers has been approached for comment. Poundland has filed a notice of intention to appoint administrators, which protects it from its creditors until Thursday. Access to funds was limited because of a tension between Gordon Brothers' dual role as both creditor and shareholder, a source said, but added they expected a relaxation of funds in the next two days. Last week, Poundland boss Barry Williams told staff like-for-like sales, which exclude new store openings, were up 11.4% last week, which included Halloween, but said this was £1.5m ahead of budget. He said the business made a profit of £18.1m in the year to September, which was a "strong recovery" from the previous year where the business made losses of £68m. The latest annual accounts have yet to be audited. - Burnham 'ready to support' Poundland staff as retailer faces collapse - Published29 October - Poundland staff protest after chain approach administrators - Published29 October However, Gordon Brothers has painted a different picture of the business, saying the chain remains "challenged and vulnerable to any potential downturn in future trading". It said it had provided significant funding to support the company's ability to trade since it acquired the business. It has also made £18m, from a combination of debt interest payments and other fees and charges. On Wednesday, executives from Gordon Brothers will appear before the Business Select Committee with MPs probing whether they are genuinely pursuing a solvent rescue of the business, which has 11,000 employees, and whether every realistic step is being taken to protect jobs and stores. The session is being held in private given commercially sensitive discussions are still under way with bidders. Uncertain future On Thursday, the 10-day moratorium to protect Poundland from its creditors expires, but if there is a prospect of a solvent deal, the deadline could be extended. If not, Poundland is set to collapse into administration and could be broken up. A source familiar with the sales process said London-based Xyra Group was making "significant progress" in its last minute bid to buy Poundland and could now be the front runner. An extension of Thursday's deadline now seems an increasingly likely scenario. But such a case would be difficult to put forward if Gordon Brothers continues to block funding. One observer remarked "if Gordon Brothers is going in front of that committee, you don't want to be giving the message we're pulling up the drawbridge". Even if a deal is agreed to sell the business as a whole, there is no guarantee a new owner would not reduce the number of stores, but suppliers to Poundland would prefer that outcome to hundreds of sites being sold off to other retailers. There has been interest from the likes of Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M in picking up stores which could mean continuing employment for many workers. The central issue is whether a piecemeal sale would protect more jobs than a buyer willing to keep Poundland trading as a national chain.

articles.title: Apple'dan Türkiye'ye 7 yeni merkez yatırımı! İlk açılış 2027'de
articles.summary: Apple, Türkiye'de beş ücretsiz geliştirici akademisi, İstanbul'da bir Developer Center ve Ankara'da bir üretim akademisi açacak. İlk merkezlerin 2027'de faaliyete geçmesi planlanıyor.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Apple'dan Türkiye'ye 7 yeni merkez yatırımı! İlk açılış 2027'de
articles.summaryTr: Apple, Türkiye'de beş ücretsiz geliştirici akademisi, İstanbul'da bir Developer Center ve Ankara'da bir üretim akademisi açacak. İlk merkezlerin 2027'de faaliyete geçmesi planlanıyor.
articles.articleText: Apple'dan Türkiye'ye 7 yeni merkez yatırımı! İlk açılış 2027'de - Apple, Türkiye'de beş ücretsiz geliştirici akademisi, İstanbul'da bir Developer Center ve Ankara'da bir üretim akademisi açacak. İlk merkezlerin 2027'de faaliyete geçmesi planlanıyor. Teknoloji devi Apple, Türkiye'deki faaliyetlerini genişletmek amacıyla yedi yeni eğitim ve teknoloji merkezi kuracağını duyurdu. 9 Kasım'da açıklanan yatırım planı kapsamında Türkiye genelinde beş Apple Developer Academy, İstanbul'da bir Apple Developer Center ve Ankara'da bir Apple Manufacturing Academy açılacak. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yazılım geliştirme, girişimcilik ve ileri üretim teknolojilerine odaklanacak merkezlerle Türkiye'deki yazılım geliştiricilerin desteklenmesi ve küçük ve orta ölçekli işletmelerin yapay zeka destekli üretim teknolojilerine erişiminin artırılması hedefleniyor. Apple, yatırımın toplam maliyetini açıklamadı. Şirketin takvimine göre ilk geliştirici akademisi ve İstanbul'daki geliştirici merkezi 2027'de, Ankara'daki üretim akademisi ise 2028'de faaliyete başlayacak. Türkiye'de beş ücretsiz geliştirici akademisi açılacak Apple, önümüzdeki üç yıl içinde Türkiye'nin farklı noktalarında beş Apple Developer Academy kurmayı planlıyor. İlk akademi 2027 yılında İstanbul'da açılacak. Diğer dört merkezin hangi şehirlerde kurulacağı henüz açıklanmadı. Akademilerde öğrencilere ve girişimcilere dokuz ay süren ücretsiz ve yoğun eğitim programları sunulacak. Eğitimlerde kodlama, uygulama tasarımı, pazarlama, proje yönetimi ve yapay zeka teknolojilerine odaklanılacak. Programlarda erişilebilirlik, kullanıcı gizliliği ve sürdürülebilirlik konuları da ele alınacak. Apple, akademilerden önümüzdeki yıllarda binlerce öğrencinin yararlanabileceğini belirtiyor. Ancak başvuru tarihleri, kabul koşulları ve kontenjanlar henüz duyurulmadı. İstanbul, Apple'ın geliştirici merkezleri arasına katılacak Apple, 2027 yılında İstanbul'da bir Apple Developer Center da açacak. Merkez, profesyonel yazılım geliştiricilere ve teknoloji girişimlerine yönelik hizmet verecek. Geliştiriciler burada Apple uzmanlarıyla birlikte çalışma, yeni teknolojileri deneyimleme ve uygulamalarını geliştirme imkanı bulacak. Yüz yüze eğitimler, teknik atölyeler, bire bir uzman görüşmeleri ve geliştirici etkinlikleri düzenlenecek. İstanbul'daki merkez, Apple'ın Bengaluru, Berlin, Cupertino, Şanghay ve Singapur'da bulunan geliştirici merkezleri ağına katılacak. Ankara'da yapay zeka ve robotik akademisi kurulacak Yatırım planının üretim teknolojilerine yönelik ayağı ise Ankara'da hayata geçirilecek. 2028 yılında açılması planlanan Apple Manufacturing Academy, Apple'ın ABD dışındaki ilk üretim akademisi olacak. Merkezde özellikle küçük ve orta ölçekli işletmelere yönelik ücretsiz eğitimler verilecek. Programların odağında yapay zeka, makine öğrenmesi, gelişmiş otomasyon, robotik sistemler ve tahmine dayalı bakım teknolojileri bulunacak. Akademide uygulamalı eğitim laboratuvarları, teknoloji gösterimleri, ortak çalışma alanları ve profesyonel gelişim etkinlikleri de yer alacak. Ankara'daki tesisin bir üretim fabrikası olmayacağının altını çizmek gerekiyor. Merkez, Apple cihazlarının üretileceği bir tesis değil; Türkiye'deki işletmelerin ileri üretim teknolojileri konusunda eğitim ve destek alabileceği bir akademi olarak tasarlandı. Tim Cook: Türkiye'deki girişimcileri destekleyeceğiz Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook, Türkiye'deki yatırım planına ilişkin açıklamasında şirketin 35 yıldır Türkiye'deki müşterilerine ve topluluklara hizmet verdiğini hatırlattı. Türkiye'deki yazılım geliştiricilerin dünya genelinde kullanılan uygulamalar ürettiğine dikkat çeken Cook, küçük ve orta ölçekli işletmelerin de ülke ekonomisinde önemli fırsatlar yarattığını belirtti. Cook, yeni merkezlerle geliştiricilere ve işletmelere eğitim, teknoloji kaynakları ve Apple uzmanlarına doğrudan erişim sağlamayı hedeflediklerini ifade etti. Apple'ın açıkladığı plan, Türkiye'de yazılım geliştirme ve ileri üretim teknolojileri alanlarında yeni eğitim imkanları oluşturmayı amaçlıyor. Ancak yatırımın toplam finansal büyüklüğü, yaratacağı istihdam ve merkezlerin kesin öğrenci kapasiteleri henüz açıklanmış değil.

articles.title: At least 39 die after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
articles.summary: The Atlantic crossing to Spain's Canary Islands remains dangerous for migrants seeking a better life
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: At least 39 die after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
articles.summaryTr: The Atlantic crossing to Spain's Canary Islands remains dangerous for migrants seeking a better life
articles.articleText: At least 39 die after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal - Published At least 39 people have died after a boat carrying migrants sank off the coast of Senegal, the Senegalese Press Agency (APS) reports. The interior ministry said one person had been rescued, but the number of people still missing was yet to be established. The small wooden boat capsized between the capital, Dakar and the northern city of Saint-Louis, as it headed towards Spain's Canary Islands. Spanish migrant rights group Walking Borders recorded 635 deaths on the Atlantic route to the Canary Islands between January and May 2026, the highest toll among the routes it monitors. Saliou Diouf, founder of Senegalese migrant aid group Boza Fii, told the AFP news agency that all the bodies recovered by Sunday evening were Senegalese. The nationalities of other people on board was yet to be established, as search operations continued. Four bodies were recovered on Monday morning in an advanced state of decomposition and buried following a collective funeral prayer organised by the fire service. Rescue teams are searching along a 25km (15-mile)- stretch of coastline, but operations have been complicated by difficult access and strong ocean currents, which are pushing bodies further south. Authorities say 24 of the 39 victims have been identified and their bodies returned to their families, while 11 others are still awaiting identification. President Bassirou Diomaye Faye has expressed his condolences to the victims' families and urged Senegalese nationals not to risk their lives on the dangerous sea crossings. In a statement posted on X, he pledged to intensify efforts to dismantle the networks organising the journeys. "We will relentlessly continue the fight against those who organise these crossings and the work that gives our young people reasons to hope here," he said. The tragedy comes amid renewed concerns over the dangers facing migrant attempting to reach Europe by sea. Walking Borders estimates that about 21 people died for every 100 who reached the Canary Islands during the period it monitored. Senegalese authorities said they had intercepted another boat, on Friday, carrying 142 migrants attempting to reach Spain. Those on board included 23 women, two babies and two other children. Police said the group comprised nationals of Senegal, Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, Guinea and Nigeria. Meanwhile, a state of emergency was declared on the Spanish island of El Hierro on Saturday following a surge in migrant arrivals. More than 3,300 people have reached the island in about 30 boats since the beginning of November, according to local authorities. This amounts to almost a third of the population on the island, one of the main entry points into Europe for migrants arriving from West Africa. Fernando Clavijo, president of the Canary Islands regional government, described the situation as "absolutely unsustainable," reports the Reuters news agency. The route has grown in prominence amid tighter controls and increased cooperation between European countries and North African states, which may have diverted some journeys away from the central Mediterranean. Limited employment opportunities, family pressures and established migration networks are among the factors driving people to leave Senegal, according to the International Organization for Migration (IOM). For many young people, the prospect of finding work and earning more abroad remains a powerful incentive, despite the risks of crossing the Atlantic in overcrowded boat. Nearly one in four young people in Senegal was unemployed in the second quarter of 2026, according to the country's statistics agency. The figure highlights the challenge facing President Faye's government as it seeks to create jobs for a predominantly young population that overwhelmingly voted for him in the 2024 elections. In a statement on Sunday, Senegal's interior ministry said it would continue efforts to combat people-smuggling networks, including by strengthening cooperation with neighbouring countries. articles.titleTr: BİM'in (BIMAS) kârı yüzde 79 arttı! Üçüncü çeyrekte 10,4 milyar TL net kâr
articles.summaryTr: BİM, 2026'nın ilk 9 ayında 26,15 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 79 artarken, üçüncü çeyrek kârı 10,39 milyar TL ile piyasa beklentilerini aştı.
articles.articleText: BİM'in (BIMAS) kârı yüzde 79 arttı! Üçüncü çeyrekte 10,4 milyar TL net kâr - BİM, 2026'nın ilk 9 ayında 26,15 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 79 artarken, üçüncü çeyrek kârı 10,39 milyar TL ile piyasa beklentilerini aştı. BİM Birleşik Mağazalar A.Ş. (BIMAS), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını 9 Kasım'da Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde 26 milyar 151 milyon 834 bin TL net dönem kârı elde etti. BİM, 2025'in aynı döneminde 14 milyar 598 milyon 567 bin TL net kâr açıklamıştı. Böylece şirketin 9 aylık net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 79 arttı. BİM'in yalnızca 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğindeki net kârı ise 10 milyar 385 milyon 559 bin TL olarak gerçekleşti. Satış gelirleri 720 milyar TL'yi aştı BİM'in ilk 9 aylık hasılatı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 665 milyar 220 milyon 543 bin TL'den 720 milyar 477 milyon 782 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Böylece satış gelirlerinde yıllık bazda yaklaşık yüzde 8 artış kaydedildi. Şirketin esas faaliyet kârı aynı dönemde 11 milyar 356 milyon 187 bin TL'den 18 milyar 301 milyon 878 bin TL'ye yükseldi. FAVÖK ise 2025'in ilk 9 ayında 38 milyar 121 milyon 696 bin TL seviyesindeyken, 2026'nın aynı döneminde 43 milyar 470 milyon 121 bin TL olarak gerçekleşti. BİM'in varlıkları 466,5 milyar TL'ye ulaştı Şirketin toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 420 milyar 296 milyon 721 bin TL'den 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği sonunda 466 milyar 542 milyon 192 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 212 milyar 575 milyon 121 bin TL'den 242 milyar 966 milyon 440 bin TL'ye çıktı. Özkaynaklar ise 205 milyar 844 milyon 477 bin TL'den 221 milyar 686 milyon 578 bin TL'ye ulaştı. BİM'in fiyat/kazanç (F/K) oranı 13,19, piyasa değeri/defter değeri (PD/DD) oranı 2,07 olarak açıklandı. Şirketin piyasa değeri 457,80 milyar TL seviyesinde bulunuyor. BİM bilançosu beklentileri aştı Matriks Haber tarafından gerçekleştirilen bilanço anketine 15 aracı kurum katıldı. Ankete göre BİM'in üçüncü çeyrek net kârına ilişkin ortalama beklenti 8 milyar 777 milyon 800 bin TL, medyan beklenti ise 8 milyar 772 milyon TL oldu. Şirketin açıkladığı 10 milyar 385 milyon 559 bin TL'lik üçüncü çeyrek net kârı, hem ortalama hem de medyan beklentinin üzerinde gerçekleşti.

articles.title: Action on energy costs is my overriding aim, says Fahnbulleh
articles.summary: The energy secretary says reducing bills is key to maintaining public support for climate action.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Action on energy costs is my overriding aim, says Fahnbulleh
articles.summaryTr: The energy secretary says reducing bills is key to maintaining public support for climate action.
articles.articleText: Action on energy costs is my overriding aim, says Fahnbulleh - Published The energy secretary has stressed that affordability is her "overriding objective", as she said reducing bills would be key to maintaining public support for climate action. Speaking to BBC Panorama, Miatta Fahnbulleh insisted that the government's drive for cleaner power would help to cut energy bills in the long term. But she conceded that the push to reduce carbon emissions was currently "under pressure" amid discontent at rising prices in recent years. It comes as ministers grapple with how to respond to a predicted surge in energy prices in January, expected to mark the biggest rise in bills for four years. - Scientists predict 2026 hottest year on record as climate talks begin - Published10 hours ago - Government's EV targets expected to be reduced this week - Published5 hours ago Labour has faced extra political pressure over its climate ambitions since coming to power, as Reform UK rose in opinion polls and the Conservatives under Kemi Badenoch disowned their previous ambition of reaching net zero by 2050. Both opposition parties have taken particular aim at public subsidy schemes designed to boost renewable sources of electricity generation, arguing that the drive for cleaner energy has driven up costs for consumers. UK households currently pay one of the highest rates for electricity in Europe. Bills have increased due to subsidies but also because of the high price of gas (a fossil fuel) driven up by international conflicts. Asked during her Panorama interview what her main task was, Fahnbulleh replied: "With the cost of living biting, affordability is my overriding objective, without a doubt." In the interview, which was recorded last week, and aired on Monday night, she argued that Labour's push for greener electricity was "one of our routes to delivering affordability". "The drive to clean power is about decoupling our dependence on global fossil fuel markets," she added. "Ultimately if we have homegrown renewables, nuclear, that's the way in which we will drive bills in the long term." However, she conceded that struggles over energy affordability were part of the reason the consensus on climate action was "under pressure". "People want to blame net zero for that. Now, I don't believe that's the case. "But I'm very clear that part of the way in which we build and maintain public consent is that we've got to show that this transition, which we have to do on climate grounds, is good for people's pockets." Fire and Floods: Our Extreme Weather The BBC's climate editor, Justin Rowlatt, investigates the impact of the changing climate on our weather. Watch on BBC iPlayer or on BBC One (BBC Two in Northern Ireland) at 20:00 on Monday 9 November. The UK had a record number of heatwaves this summer and suffered successive damaging wildfires, which the Met Office has said was made 130 times more likely by climate change. Just last month, whilst hosting the UK's first summit on wildfires, Andy Burnham acknowledged that as a result of climate change "the summer we've just had is likely to be a more regular situation going forward". But he has also vowed to lead a "cost of living government" and reindustralise the economy. This has prompted some in Westminster to speculate that he could demote climate action to help reduce energy costs in the short-term. His government has dismayed some green activists by diverting funding from the energy department to help meet defence funding targets, including money previously earmarked for energy efficiency schemes. Last month the government approved drilling at the Jackdaw gas field which also prompted criticism from some campaigners, although ministers have sought to argue it will minimise imports of higher emission fuels. A decision is yet to be taken on whether production can begin at Rosebank, the UK's largest known untapped oil field, located off the coast of Shetland. Speaking to Panorama, Fahnbulleh insisted reducing carbon emissions "absolutely is a priority", pointing to this summer's droughts as evidence of the need to tackle global warming. However, she conceded that Labour's target for 95% of electricity generated in Britain to come from clean power sources by 2030 was a "stretch". On Monday, it was reported that the government is considering weakening the electric vehicle mandate requiring car manufacturers to phase out production of petrol and diesel cars by 2035. This could prove a blow to not only the country's climate targets but the UK's claim to be providing leadership on the issues just as ministers head to Turkey for COP31, the UN's climate summit. - Government's EV targets expected to be reduced this week - Published5 hours ago Sign up for our Politics Essential newsletter to keep up with the inner workings of Westminster and beyond.

articles.summary: Turkcell, 2026'nın ilk 9 ayında 17,5 milyar TL net kâr elde etti. Yıllık kâr artışı yüzde 0,5'te kalırken, üçüncü çeyrek net kârı 6,74 milyar TL ile piyasa beklentilerinin üzerine çıktı.

articles.summaryTr: Turkcell, 2026'nın ilk 9 ayında 17,5 milyar TL net kâr elde etti. Yıllık kâr artışı yüzde 0,5'te kalırken, üçüncü çeyrek net kârı 6,74 milyar TL ile piyasa beklentilerinin üzerine çıktı.
articles.articleText: Turkcell (TCELL) 3. çeyrekte beklentileri aştı: İşte dev şirketin net karı - Turkcell, 2026'nın ilk 9 ayında 17,5 milyar TL net kâr elde etti. Yıllık kâr artışı yüzde 0,5'te kalırken, üçüncü çeyrek net kârı 6,74 milyar TL ile piyasa beklentilerinin üzerine çıktı. Turkcell İletişim Hizmetleri A.Ş. (TCELL), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını 9 Kasım'da Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde 17 milyar 499 milyon 506 bin TL net dönem kârı açıkladı. Turkcell, 2025'in aynı döneminde 17 milyar 417 milyon 318 bin TL net kâr elde etmişti. Böylece şirketin 9 aylık net kârı yıllık bazda yaklaşık yüzde 0,5 arttı. Turkcell'in yalnızca 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğindeki net kârı ise 6 milyar 737 milyon 29 bin TL olarak gerçekleşti. Satış gelirleri 235 milyar TL'yi aştı Turkcell'in ilk 9 aylık hasılatı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 222 milyar 94 milyon 491 bin TL'den 235 milyar 65 milyon 367 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Böylece satış gelirlerinde yıllık bazda yaklaşık yüzde 6 artış kaydedildi. Şirketin esas faaliyet kârı ise aynı dönemde 72 milyar 9 milyon 385 bin TL'den 46 milyar 332 milyon 274 bin TL'ye geriledi. FAVÖK, 2025'in ilk 9 ayında 98 milyar 303 milyon 609 bin TL seviyesindeyken, 2026'nın aynı döneminde 101 milyar 228 milyon 202 bin TL oldu. Turkcell'in varlıkları 715 milyar TL'ye ulaştı Şirketin toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 622 milyar 298 milyon 214 bin TL'den 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği sonunda 715 milyar 138 milyon 906 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 299 milyar 902 milyon 560 bin TL'den 381 milyar 866 milyon 888 bin TL'ye çıktı. Özkaynaklar ise 322 milyar 395 milyon 654 bin TL'den 333 milyar 272 milyon 18 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Turkcell'in fiyat/kazanç (F/K) oranı 9,22, piyasa değeri/defter değeri (PD/DD) oranı 0,61 olarak açıklandı. Şirketin piyasa değeri 202,61 milyar TL seviyesinde bulunuyor. Turkcell bilançosu beklentileri aştı Matriks Haber tarafından gerçekleştirilen bilanço anketine 14 aracı kurum katıldı. Ankete göre Turkcell'in üçüncü çeyrek net kârına ilişkin ortalama beklenti 5 milyar 389 milyon 200 bin TL, medyan beklenti ise 5 milyar 393 milyon 500 bin TL oldu. Şirketin açıkladığı 6 milyar 737 milyon 29 bin TL'lik üçüncü çeyrek net kârı, hem ortalama hem de medyan beklentinin üzerinde gerçekleşti.

articles.summaryTr: Gübretaş, 2026'nın ilk 9 ayında 7,47 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 43 artarken, satış gelirleri yüzde 22 yükseldi. Üçüncü çeyrek net kârı ise 2,44 milyar TL oldu.
articles.articleText: Gübretaş'ın (GUBRF) kârı yüzde 43 arttı! İşte 3. çeyrek bilançosunun detayları - Gübretaş, 2026'nın ilk 9 ayında 7,47 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 43 artarken, satış gelirleri yüzde 22 yükseldi. Üçüncü çeyrek net kârı ise 2,44 milyar TL oldu. Gübre Fabrikaları T.A.Ş. (GUBRF), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını 9 Kasım'da Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde 7 milyar 474 milyon 337 bin 617 TL net dönem kârı elde etti. Gübretaş, 2025'in aynı döneminde 5 milyar 236 milyon 331 bin 186 TL net kâr açıklamıştı. Böylece şirketin 9 aylık net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 43 arttı. Şirketin yalnızca 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde elde ettiği net kâr ise 2 milyar 443 milyon 692 bin 923 TL olarak gerçekleşti. Satış gelirleri 58 milyar TL'yi aştı Gübretaş'ın ilk 9 aylık hasılatı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 47 milyar 772 milyon 240 bin 262 TL'den 58 milyar 62 milyon 424 bin 941 TL'ye yükseldi. Böylece satış gelirlerinde yıllık bazda yüzde 22 artış kaydedildi. Esas faaliyet kârı da aynı dönemde 9 milyar 481 milyon 473 bin 595 TL'den 9 milyar 705 milyon 139 bin 940 TL'ye çıktı. Artış oranı yaklaşık yüzde 2 oldu. Şirketin FAVÖK'ü ise 2025'in ilk 9 ayında 10 milyar 467 milyon 876 bin TL seviyesindeyken, 2026'nın aynı döneminde 11 milyar 396 milyon 362 bin TL olarak gerçekleşti. Gübretaş'ın varlıkları 85,5 milyar TL'ye yükseldi Şirketin toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 80 milyar 124 milyon 51 bin 630 TL'den 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği sonunda 85 milyar 524 milyon 130 bin 680 TL'ye ulaştı. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 35 milyar 416 milyon 843 bin 191 TL'den 37 milyar 19 milyon 570 bin 270 TL'ye yükseldi. Özkaynaklar ise 37 milyar 36 milyon 988 bin 287 TL'den 42 milyar 387 milyon 992 bin 564 TL'ye çıktı. GUBRF'nin piyasa değeri 102,5 milyar TL Gübretaş'ın finansal tablolarına göre şirketin fiyat/kazanç (F/K) oranı 11,66, piyasa değeri/defter değeri (PD/DD) oranı ise 2,42 olarak açıklandı. Şirketin piyasa değeri 102,50 milyar TL seviyesinde bulunuyor.

articles.title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
articles.summary: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.

articles.titleTr: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
articles.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.
articles.articleText: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published One of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry's most important figures has been accused of having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, prompting an investigation. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. On Sunday, Huang admitted, external to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US tech giant Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, has opened an independent investigation into the reports. The firm said it does not believe US national security had been compromised - and added that Huang was committed to continuing to lead the company. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. Who is Alice Huang and what do we know about the affair? US officials believed that Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. Her current whereabouts are unknown. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. The firm had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia maintains was investigated and debunked. However, the BBC understands Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singapore government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. She did not respond to the paper's request for comment. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. "We trust that if we were the target of a genuine threat, the US government would have notified us," an Nvidia spokesperson told the BBC. China has rejected the spying allegations. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters on Monday at a regular daily press briefing: "We have already responded to this. The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." The New York Times reported in late October that Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he wished he had "acted on the intelligence", Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's an honourable guy." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Huang. Last spring, the secretary of state reportedly oversaw the drafting of a memo that warned the Trump administration about Huang's relationship with the Chinese businesswoman, according to the New York Times. Why does it matter? Nvidia is at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among American lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of US companies like Nvidia, working with producers like the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying that Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. Huang has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. Sunday's revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic and perfectionist with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. Huang has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. Trump said he had not spoken to the Nvidia boss since news of the investigation emerged. "I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what's going on," Trump told reporters, adding that he had "done an amazing job for our country". What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. "Today when we think of that, we think of these giant data centres - none of that existed. There were no customers for the stuff he was building. In fact his first customer was Open AI at the time they had 30 people - he actually gave it to them, he donated it to them," Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure, including Amazon, Meta, Google, and Microsoft, now use Nvidia chips. Currently worth $4.5tn (£3.4tn), Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies ever. For now, the firm's board appears to have little appetite for removing Huang, saying in a statement on Sunday that they have "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team". Sources tell the BBC his removal is unlikely because there is so much money at stake. There is no public succession plan for the 63-year-old. He has often said he hopes to continue in the role for decades, and Bloomberg reports he has created an informal leadership structure around him unlike a traditional company's hierarchy. His children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez work at Nvidia in senior roles. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

articles.summary: Borsa İstanbul, Volatilite Bazlı Tedbir Sistemi (VBTS) kapsamında Kartonsan (KARTN) paylarına yönelik tedbir kararı aldı. Hissede açığa satış ve kredili işlem yasağı 10 Kasım'da başlayacak.

articles.titleTr: Borsada bir hissede tedbir kararı: Kredili işlem ve açığa satış yasağı geldi
articles.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul, Volatilite Bazlı Tedbir Sistemi (VBTS) kapsamında Kartonsan (KARTN) paylarına yönelik tedbir kararı aldı. Hissede açığa satış ve kredili işlem yasağı 10 Kasım'da başlayacak.
articles.articleText: Borsada bir hissede tedbir kararı: Kredili işlem ve açığa satış yasağı geldi - Borsa İstanbul, Volatilite Bazlı Tedbir Sistemi (VBTS) kapsamında Kartonsan (KARTN) paylarına yönelik tedbir kararı aldı. Hissede açığa satış ve kredili işlem yasağı 10 Kasım'da başlayacak. Borsa İstanbul, Kartonsan Karton Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. (KARTN) paylarına yönelik tedbir uygulanacağını duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) 9 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yayımlanan açıklamaya göre, Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK) kararı doğrultusunda Volatilite Bazlı Tedbir Sistemi (VBTS) kapsamında KARTN payları açığa satışa ve kredili işlemlere konu edilemeyecek. Tedbir, 10 Kasım 2026 tarihli işlemlerden seans başında başlayacak ve 9 Aralık 2026 tarihli işlemlerin seans sonuna kadar devam edecek. VBTS nedir? Volatilite Bazlı Tedbir Sistemi, Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören paylarda aşırı fiyat hareketlerinin önüne geçilmesi ve piyasa istikrarının desteklenmesi amacıyla uygulanıyor. Sistem kapsamında hisselere belirli sürelerle açığa satış ve kredili işlem yasağı gibi tedbirler getirilebiliyor.

(DOAS), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını 9 Kasım'da Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde 2 milyar 53 milyon 494 bin TL net dönem kârı elde etti. Doğuş Otomotiv, 2025'in aynı döneminde 6 milyar 554 milyon 183 bin TL net kâr açıklamıştı. Böylece şirketin 9 aylık net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 69 geriledi. Şirketin yalnızca 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğindeki net sonucu ise 434 milyon 107 bin TL zarar oldu. Satış gelirleri yüzde 24 azaldı Doğuş Otomotiv'in ilk 9 aylık hasılatı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 221 milyar 659 milyon 384 bin TL'den 168 milyar 708 milyon 906 bin TL'ye geriledi. Böylece satış gelirlerinde yıllık bazda yaklaşık yüzde 24 düşüş kaydedildi. Esas faaliyet kârı da aynı dönemde 13 milyar 941 milyon 512 bin TL'den 4 milyar 573 milyon 675 bin TL'ye düştü. Esas faaliyet kârındaki gerileme yüzde 67 oldu. Şirketin FAVÖK'ü ise 2025'in ilk 9 ayında 15 milyar 364 milyon 426 bin TL seviyesindeyken, 2026'nın aynı döneminde 7 milyar 531 milyon 965 bin TL olarak gerçekleşti. Varlıklar ve özkaynaklar geriledi Doğuş Otomotiv'in toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 162 milyar 71 milyon 285 bin TL'den 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği sonunda 153 milyar 415 milyon 210 bin TL'ye geriledi. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 77 milyar 399 milyon 262 bin TL'den 74 milyar 254 milyon 341 bin TL'ye, özkaynaklar ise 83 milyar 477 milyon 96 bin TL'den 78 milyar 6 milyon 705 bin TL'ye düştü. Şirketin piyasa değeri 30,40 milyar TL, PD/DD oranı ise 0,39 olarak açıklandı. DOAS bilançosu beklentileri karşılayamadı Matriks Haber tarafından gerçekleştirilen bilanço anketine 13 aracı kurum katıldı. Ankete göre Doğuş Otomotiv'in üçüncü çeyrek net kârına ilişkin ortalama beklenti 851 milyon 500 bin TL, medyan beklenti ise 842 milyon TL oldu. Şirketin açıkladığı 434 milyon 107 bin TL'lik net zarar, piyasa beklentilerinin oldukça altında kaldı. Böylece DOAS, üçüncü çeyrekte analist beklentilerini karşılayamadı.

articles.summary: Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman, had a close relationship with Nvidia boss Jensen Huang, reports say.

articles.titleTr: Who is the suspected Chinese spy at centre of the Nvidia investigation?
articles.summaryTr: Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman, had a close relationship with Nvidia boss Jensen Huang, reports say.
articles.articleText: Who is the suspected Chinese spy at centre of the Nvidia investigation? US chip giant Nvidia has said it is investigating reports that its CEO Jensen Huang had a close relationship with Alice Huang, who had been the managing director of Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed. The New York Times reported that US officials suspect Alice Huang has been working for China's spy agency to collect intelligence. China has denied allegations of Huang being a Chinese spy, calling the allegations "entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." Nvidia says it has no reason to believe its secrets or national security were compromised, but will "examine all available information". Asia reporter Tessa Wong explains what we know about Alice Huang, and her links to Jensen Huang.

Binance’s pledge to cover user losses from its $6.3 billion hack helped contain the fallout across crypto markets, analysts told Cointelegraph. “There doesn’t seem to be any contagion-type effect from the hack, given that Binance is able to cover the losses using its balance sheet,” Martin Lee, market insights lead at DWF Labs, told Cointelegraph. He said investors turned their focus to the implications of the US midterm elections. Binance’s daily net outflows fell to $458 million in the 24 hours leading to Monday’s publication time, down from $6.1 billion on Nov. 2 after withdrawals resumed, according to DefiLlama. Attackers stole about $6.3 billion from Binance hot wallets in the Oct. 29 breach, making it the largest crypto hack to date. Bitcoin (BTC) fell as much as 5.7% over the first five days after the hack, a decline CryptoQuant called “modest” in its Wednesday report . Bitcoin fell roughly 13.6% after the $1.4 billion Bybit hack in 2025 and about 9.9% after the Coincheck hack in 2018. At least 14 of the past 38 hacks CryptoQuant reviewed were followed by steeper Bitcoin declines. Bitcoin’s drawdown after the Binance hack, compared to previous exchange hacks. Source: CryptoQuant Major exchange hacks have previously triggered “short-lived drawdowns that markets later absorbed” as long-term holder demand returned, Lacie Zhang, research lead at Bitget Wallet, told Cointelegraph, adding that the Binance hack does not represent a “structural trend reversal” for crypto markets. Related: Binance hackers had 8-week intrusion window before $6.3B exploit: SEAL Bitfinex analysts say CPI could help confirm a Bitcoin bottom “Much of the hack’s impact now looks priced in,” with Bitcoin currently trading at an “attractive level,” Bitfinex analysts told Cointelegraph. “Confirmation of a market bottom now depends on the Consumer Price Index (CPI) reading due on 10 November, which will shape the Federal Reserve’s next rate decision. Higher bond yields would put pressure on risk assets.” Market participants priced in an 80% chance that the Federal Reserve will raise rates at its Dec. 9 meeting, up from 69% a month earlier, according to the CMEGroup’s FedWatch tool. Bitcoin fell 2.5% over 24 hours to $74,580 as of 1:21 pm UTC on Monday, according to CoinMarketCap. Magazine: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest

articles.title: Thirteen migrants die after boat sinks off Crete
articles.summary: The Greek coastguard says it has rescued 18 people, all of whom were Sudanese nationals.

articles.titleTr: Thirteen migrants die after boat sinks off Crete
articles.summaryTr: The Greek coastguard says it has rescued 18 people, all of whom were Sudanese nationals.
articles.articleText: Thirteen migrants die after boat sinks off Crete - Published At least 13 people have died after a boat carrying migrants sank off the coast of the Greek island of Crete. The coastguard said it had rescued 18 people, all of whom were Sudanese nationals. Four of the survivors were taken to hospital, including a toddler. Authorities said it was not immediately clear what caused the deaths, but they believe the boat had been at sea for days and had struggled to reach shore due to strong winds. Crete remains one of several key gateways for migrants attempting to reach Europe from the Middle East and North Africa, with more than 22,000 of the 86,400 sea arrivals so far this year landing in Crete alone. One unnamed coastguard official who spoke to news agency Reuters on condition of anonymity said the survivors were "shivering from the cold". The migrants' boat was spotted by a Moroccan-flagged container ship about 15 nautical miles (28km) off Crete's coast. The Greek coastguard rescued another 187 people in three separate incidents off the coast of Greece on Monday. More than 37,000 migrants have arrived in Greece so far this year, UN figures show, already surpassing the number who arrived in the entirety of 2025. The Greek government has announced plans to deal with the influx, including opening a temporary housing complex near the Cretan capital, Heraklion. Greece was at the heart of Europe's migration crisis in 2015-16, when nearly a million people arrived on its islands, mostly from Turkey. Arrivals later fell as border controls tightened, but crossings from Libya have surged in recent years, particularly among people fleeing conflict in Sudan and seeking better economic opportunities from countries including Bangladesh.

articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
articles.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, the European Union called on the finance industry to write a common rulebook for tokenized securities, Zcash developers seek another reduction in block times and Binance France is closing up shop in the country. EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities The European Central Bank, European Commission and European Securities and Markets Authority are seeking nominations for an industry-led group that will draft common standards for holding and settling tokenized securities. Eligible applicants include EU industry associations, global institutions, private firms and fintech companies. They can apply to the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG) by Nov. 27, with work set to begin in January 2027, according to a release published Monday. The three EU institutions will participate as observers. The group will develop technical and market standards to help companies hold and settle tokenized securities across different distributed ledger technology (DLT) platforms and ensure those platforms can work with existing financial systems. The group aims to produce an initial set of standards by early 2028, according to its mandate. The standards will support Appia, the Eurosystem’s initiative to develop a blueprint for Europe’s tokenized financial markets. The institutions warned that fragmentation could limit the benefits of tokenization and said the group may recommend ways for EU authorities to encourage firms to adopt its standards. In September, the Eurosystem launched Pontes, a system that allows financial institutions to settle wholesale transactions in tokenized assets in central bank money. Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade Zcash developers have proposed reducing the blockchain’s target block interval from 25 seconds to 20 seconds, seeking faster transaction confirmations days after activating the NU7 upgrade. On Sunday, developers ValarDragon and Evan Forbes submitted a draft Zcash Improvement Proposal (ZIP) on GitHub, saying that they want the change to be included in the next community poll and considered for the upcoming NU7.1 network upgrade. The reduction would shorten the expected wait for initial transaction confirmations. According to the proposal, this would improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps. The developers said the change would not increase the network’s overall daily capacity for private transactions. The proposal would also preserve Zcash’s existing issuance schedule, despite blocks being produced more frequently. The proposal comes just days after Zcash’s NU7 upgrade went live. On Friday, the NU7 upgrade was activated on the mainnet, cutting the network’s target block interval from 75 seconds to 25 seconds. The upgrade also introduced a Network Sustainability Mechanism designed to recycle a portion of transaction fees into future mining rewards while preserving Zcash’s 21 million ZEC supply cap. Binance France emails announce closure of accounts Dec. 31 Binance France is closing up shop in the country. Customers have been notified by email during early November, according to media reports. All accounts will be closed on Dec. 31, and any assets left on the exchange will be charged monthly fees starting on Nov. 29, Cryptoast, Crypto Briefing and other media reported on Saturday, citing emails sent to users by Binance. On that date, accounts still maintaining a balance will pay a monthly maintenance fee of 0.025% of the balance, or a minimum of 10 USDC, a stablecoin tracking the US dollar. To avoid fees, withdrawals must be completed by Nov. 29, the exchange said.
